useCases.name: Fault Demarcation
useCases.description: Determines the most likely responsible domain or team for a fault using topology, diagnostics, alarms and service context.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces incorrect referrals and accelerates restoration.
useCases.outputs: Fault domain, responsible team, supporting evidence and next investigation steps.

useCases.name: Fault Mapper & Network Correlation
useCases.description: Correlates alarms, faults, events, topology, tickets and locations into one related incident picture.
useCases.businessValue: Helps teams work the real incident instead of chasing many separate symptoms.
useCases.outputs: Correlated event group, probable common cause, affected resources and impact summary.

useCases.name: Incident & Ticket Correlation
useCases.description: Links incidents, tickets, alarms and affected resources to identify parent/child relationships and duplicate tickets.
useCases.businessValue: Improves incident control and avoids duplicated impact calculations.
useCases.outputs: Incident cluster, parent ticket, child tickets, affected scope and status alignment.

useCases.name: Fault Load & Repeat Anomaly Detection
useCases.description: Detects abnormal increases in faults or repeated faults compared with historical baselines.
useCases.businessValue: Allows proactive investigation before the problem becomes a wider service issue.
useCases.outputs: Anomaly score, affected domain, trend chart, repeated elements and suspected drivers.

useCases.name: Automated Network Baseline Management
useCases.description: Builds a normal operating baseline for resources, services and KPIs from historical data and validated snapshots.
useCases.businessValue: Makes it easier to distinguish normal variation from real degradation or abnormal change.
useCases.outputs: Baseline values, thresholds, deviation score, trend profile and exceptions.

useCases.name: Referral & Closure Management
useCases.description: Audits ticket referrals and closures against technical evidence and lifecycle rules.
useCases.businessValue: Finds incorrect handovers, premature closures and process gaps that increase resolution time.
useCases.outputs: Referral quality, closure validity, bounced tickets, exceptions and improvement actions.

useCases.name: Alarm-to-Ticket Assurance
useCases.description: Checks whether actionable alarms have the required trouble tickets and correct references.
useCases.businessValue: Prevents untracked operational issues and improves accountability.
useCases.outputs: Missing-ticket list, alarm mapping, recommended ticket creation and reconciliation status.

useCases.name: Post-Closure Failure Detection
useCases.description: Audits ticket referrals and closures against technical evidence and lifecycle rules.
useCases.businessValue: Finds incorrect handovers, premature closures and process gaps that increase resolution time.
useCases.outputs: Referral quality, closure validity, bounced tickets, exceptions and improvement actions.

useCases.name: Logical Event Monitoring & Detection
useCases.description: Provides a structured capability under the Network & Service Health domain to transform network data into actionable operational intelligence.
useCases.businessValue: Supports faster decisions, better governance and clearer operational ownership.
useCases.outputs: Status, analysis summary, related assets/services, KPIs, exceptions and recommended actions.

useCases.name: On-Demand Health Check
useCases.description: Runs structured checks on devices, links, circuits or services using CLI, SNMP, APIs and related operational data.
useCases.businessValue: Gives teams a fast, consistent understanding of current health and degradation drivers.
useCases.outputs: Health score, KPI status, failed checks, analysis summary and recommended actions.

useCases.name: Daily Automated Health Check
useCases.description: Runs structured checks on devices, links, circuits or services using CLI, SNMP, APIs and related operational data.
useCases.businessValue: Gives teams a fast, consistent understanding of current health and degradation drivers.
useCases.outputs: Health score, KPI status, failed checks, analysis summary and recommended actions.

useCases.name: Health Check Population Management
useCases.description: Maintains the list of circuits/services/devices included in health checks by detecting additions, removals and modifications.
useCases.businessValue: Prevents monitoring coverage gaps and reduces manual maintenance.
useCases.outputs: Updated health-check scope, added/removed objects, source evidence and sync status.

useCases.name: Health Check vs. Inventory Discrepancies
useCases.description: Runs structured checks on devices, links, circuits or services using CLI, SNMP, APIs and related operational data.
useCases.businessValue: Gives teams a fast, consistent understanding of current health and degradation drivers.
useCases.outputs: Health score, KPI status, failed checks, analysis summary and recommended actions.

useCases.name: MDT Monitoring & Change Assurance
useCases.description: Analyzes planned activities before, during and after execution using health, topology, alarms, customers and services.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces change risk and gives operations a clear view of expected and actual impact.
useCases.outputs: Pre-impact list, affected services/customers, execution health, post-check result and closure recommendation.

useCases.name: Service Impact Analysis (SIA)
useCases.description: Traverses topology and service relationships to identify which services are technically affected by a failure or activity.
useCases.businessValue: Provides the technical impact scope required for incident decisions and communication.
useCases.outputs: Affected services, circuits, resources, direct/downstream impact and dependency path.

useCases.name: Business Impact Analysis
useCases.description: Converts technical impact into business impact by adding customer class, service criticality and priority context.
useCases.businessValue: Helps management prioritize response according to business exposure, not only alarm severity.
useCases.outputs: Customer/business impact, VIP exposure, severity classification and escalation recommendation.

useCases.name: What-If Impact Simulation
useCases.description: Simulates failure, removal, migration or traffic growth and calculates expected impact before it happens.
useCases.businessValue: Supports safer planning and more informed change or expansion decisions.
useCases.outputs: Simulated impact, affected services/customers, capacity after event and risk notes.

useCases.name: Closed RTTS Ticket related to Half Pon
Customer 360 View
useCases.description: Combines customer services, circuits, tickets, alarms, performance, complaints, health and activities in one view.
useCases.businessValue: Helps customer-facing and operations teams understand the full customer situation quickly.
useCases.outputs: Customer profile, service list, health status, incidents, complaints, MDT/MSO relation and timeline.

useCases.name: Customer Experience Health Scoring
useCases.description: Calculates customer health or experience score from technical indicators and service behavior.
useCases.businessValue: Identifies customers at risk before they formally complain or escalate.
useCases.outputs: Experience score, degradation drivers, affected services and proactive action candidates.

useCases.name: Complaint Analysis & Prediction
useCases.description: Analyzes historical complaints and current network/ticket conditions to predict complaint escalation risk.
useCases.businessValue: Allows proactive intervention for customers or tickets most likely to become complaints.
useCases.outputs: Complaint risk score, contributing factors, candidate tickets/customers and recommended action.

useCases.name: Unified Network Inventory
useCases.description: Creates a trusted inventory model for active and passive network resources, covering assets, hierarchy, locations, ports, interfaces, links, circuits and services.
useCases.businessValue: Gives operations and business teams one reliable source for network understanding instead of fragmented views across multiple tools.
useCases.outputs: Asset catalogue, hierarchy, relationships, source lineage, discrepancy flags and searchable asset views.

useCases.name: Network Element / Asset 360
useCases.description: Provides a complete 360° page for each network element or asset, combining inventory, topology, health, alarms, tickets, services, customers and impact.
useCases.businessValue: Cuts investigation time by allowing the user to understand the asset without jumping between systems.
useCases.outputs: Asset profile, connected resources, service/customer impact, current status, tickets, alarms and history.

useCases.name: Operational Load Forecasting
useCases.description: Uses historical utilization to forecast when resources will reach defined thresholds.
useCases.businessValue: Provides early planning signals before capacity becomes urgent.
useCases.outputs: Forecast date, trend line, confidence, threshold crossing and recommended timing.

useCases.name: Network Element Failure Risk Prediction
useCases.description: Provides a complete 360° page for each network element or asset, combining inventory, topology, health, alarms, tickets, services, customers and impact.
useCases.businessValue: Cuts investigation time by allowing the user to understand the asset without jumping between systems.
useCases.outputs: Asset profile, connected resources, service/customer impact, current status, tickets, alarms and history.

useCases.name: Service Maturity Index
useCases.description: Scores service maturity using stability, incidents, performance, redundancy, capacity, complaints and change history.
useCases.businessValue: Creates a management-level index that summarizes service reliability and risk.
useCases.outputs: Maturity score, rating, drivers, weak areas and improvement priorities.

useCases.name: Automated Root Cause Analysis
useCases.description: Combines alarms, topology, health, changes, tickets and performance to suggest the most probable root cause.
useCases.businessValue: Shortens analysis time during complex incidents.
useCases.outputs: Probable root cause, evidence, related symptoms, confidence and next steps.

useCases.name: AI Operations Assistant
useCases.description: Allows users to ask operational questions and receive grounded answers from portfolio data.
useCases.businessValue: Makes complex intelligence easier to consume for operations and management.
useCases.outputs: Conversational answers, cited data objects, recommended actions and follow-up exploration.

useCases.name: Closed-Loop Network Assurance
useCases.description: Detects issues, analyzes cause and impact, recommends or triggers approved remediation, then verifies recovery.
useCases.businessValue: Moves operations from reactive monitoring toward controlled automation.
useCases.outputs: Detected issue, recommended action, execution status, recovery validation and audit trail.

useCases.name: Major Outage Detection & Analysis
useCases.description: Analyzes a major outage by combining physical fault, topology, alarms, services, tickets, customers and restoration status.
useCases.businessValue: Gives the war room one controlled understanding of the outage and its impact.
useCases.outputs: Root-cause candidates, affected topology, SIA/BIA, customer list, tickets and recovery progress.

useCases.name: SPOF & Resiliency Analysis
useCases.description: Identifies single points of failure and insufficient redundancy across network resources and service paths.
useCases.businessValue: Shows where one failure can create a large operational or business impact.
useCases.outputs: Simulated impact, affected services/customers, capacity after event and risk notes.

useCases.name: Daily Install Base Delta Detection
useCases.description: Compares the latest baseline with previous snapshots to identify added, removed, replaced or modified assets.
useCases.businessValue: Highlights changes quickly and helps teams detect uncontrolled or undocumented network changes.
useCases.outputs: Daily delta list, change category, affected assets, source evidence and action status.

useCases.name: Inventory Gap & Discrepancy Management
useCases.description: Classifies missing, conflicting, duplicated or stale records and manages them as actionable exceptions.
useCases.businessValue: Improves inventory quality through a measurable correction process rather than static reports.
useCases.outputs: Gap report, discrepancy category, responsible owner, severity and closure status.

useCases.name: Install Base Validation
useCases.description: Validates installed physical assets against approved inventory and management sources.
useCases.businessValue: Identifies whether the network physically installed in the field matches what the organization believes it owns and operates.
useCases.outputs: Validation report, missing assets, unexpected assets, model/serial mismatches and evidence.

useCases.name: Inventory Data Quality Scoring
useCases.description: Scores completeness, consistency, accuracy and freshness of inventory data by technology, region and source.
useCases.businessValue: Allows management to track inventory quality as a KPI and target the weakest domains first.
useCases.outputs: Quality score, completeness percentage, stale records, mismatch trends and source ranking.

useCases.name: Unauthorized / Unregistered Asset Detection
useCases.description: Detects assets found in the live network but not registered in the approved inventory baseline.
useCases.businessValue: Supports governance, security and asset control by highlighting unmanaged infrastructure.
useCases.outputs: Unregistered asset list, evidence, location, discovered attributes and investigation status.

useCases.name: Golden Record Management
useCases.description: Applies configurable source-priority and business rules to select the trusted value for each asset and attribute.
useCases.businessValue: Creates a controlled, explainable inventory baseline that other use cases can depend on.
useCases.outputs: Golden attributes, source lineage, confidence level, rule results and exception list.

useCases.name: Pre-Change Health Check
useCases.description: Runs health and configuration checks before a change to establish the baseline and detect unsafe conditions.
useCases.businessValue: Prevents execution when the network is already unhealthy or missing prerequisites.
useCases.outputs: PRE baseline, failed checks, device readiness, warning list and go/no-go evidence.

useCases.name: Post-Change Health Check
useCases.description: Repeats checks after a change and compares the results with the pre-change baseline.
useCases.businessValue: Confirms whether the activity achieved the expected outcome without introducing new issues.
useCases.outputs: POST result, delta analysis, new failures, recovered issues and validation status.

useCases.name: Automated Change Success Validation
useCases.description: Combines health, alarms, KPIs, configuration deltas and policy results to decide whether a change is successful.
useCases.businessValue: Creates a consistent technical acceptance method for network changes.
useCases.outputs: Success score, failed validation items, risk notes and closure recommendation.

useCases.name: Change Risk Assessment
useCases.description: Calculates pre-change risk using impacted resources, redundancy, health, service/customer exposure and historical outcomes.
useCases.businessValue: Helps prioritize supervision, approval depth and rollback planning for risky activities.
useCases.outputs: Risk score, risk drivers, impacted services/customers and recommended controls.

useCases.name: PRE/POST Configuration & State Comparison
useCases.description: Compares selected configuration, command outputs and operational states before and after a change.
useCases.businessValue: Makes change validation evidence-based instead of relying only on manual confirmation.
useCases.outputs: Side-by-side differences, expected changes, unexpected deltas and technical evidence.

useCases.name: Golden Template Compliance
useCases.description: Checks device configuration against approved standard templates and expected configuration patterns.
useCases.businessValue: Improves standardization and reduces operational risk caused by inconsistent configuration.
useCases.outputs: Compliance score, missing configuration, invalid values and remediation hints.

useCases.name: Policy Compliance Validation
useCases.description: Runs configurable technical and security policy checks against configuration and operational state.
useCases.businessValue: Ensures devices follow internal standards before and after operational activities.
useCases.outputs: Pass/fail checks, evidence per rule, policy violations and exception list.

useCases.name: Configuration Drift Detection
useCases.description: Detects configuration changes that move away from the approved baseline or happen outside authorized activities.
useCases.businessValue: Finds uncontrolled changes early and supports compliance governance.
useCases.outputs: Drift report, changed commands, timestamp/source, affected devices and severity.

useCases.name: Network Digital Twin
useCases.description: Maintains a synchronized digital representation of assets, topology, configuration, services, capacity and dependencies.
useCases.businessValue: Provides a reliable simulation and analysis foundation for operations, planning and automation.
useCases.outputs: Digital network model, current state, dependencies, scenarios and change impact.

useCases.name: Network Knowledge Graph
useCases.description: Connects assets, services, customers, alarms, tickets, changes and events as a relationship graph.
useCases.businessValue: Improves search, correlation, AI reasoning and contextual analytics.
useCases.outputs: Graph model, relationship paths, connected entities and contextual insights.

useCases.name: Logical Network Topology
useCases.description: Builds logical relationships such as interfaces, IP links, VLANs, VRFs, circuits, VPNs and services.
useCases.businessValue: Connects services to the resources that actually carry them and enables service-level analysis.
useCases.outputs: Logical topology, service paths, interface relationships, VLAN/VRF mapping and circuit dependency views.

useCases.name: Event & Activity Unified Operations Dashboard
useCases.description: Builds one contextual dashboard for a specific event, major activity, war room or executive monitoring need by collecting data from multiple domains.
useCases.businessValue: Demonstrates how the portfolio works as one connected intelligence layer rather than separate tools.
useCases.outputs: Event dashboard, health view, topology impact, customer/business impact, capacity, tickets, actions and executive summary.

useCases.name: Network Reports & Operational Analytics
useCases.description: Provides standard and ad-hoc reporting across inventory, topology, assurance, capacity, faults and operations.
useCases.businessValue: Turns portfolio data into consumable insights for teams and management.
useCases.outputs: Reports, dashboards, KPIs, trends, exports and drill-down analytics.

domains.name: Service Inventory & Activation
domains.description: Portfolio domain for service inventory & activation.

useCases.name: MPLS Network Discovery & Analysis
useCases.description: Discovers and analyzes MPLS nodes, interfaces, VRFs, VPNs, routing relationships and logical connectivity.
useCases.businessValue: Provides a clear operational model for complex MPLS environments.
useCases.outputs: PE/P inventory, VRFs, logical links, service relationships and analysis views.

useCases.name: MPLS VPN & Service Topology
useCases.description: Builds topology for L2/L3 VPN services across participating nodes, VRFs, interfaces and paths.
useCases.businessValue: Allows teams to understand how VPN services are delivered and where impact may occur.
useCases.outputs: VPN topology, PE endpoints, VRF mapping, service path and customer relation.

useCases.name: MPLS Service Trace
useCases.description: Traces an MPLS service from endpoint to endpoint across logical and supporting physical resources.
useCases.businessValue: Improves troubleshooting and impact understanding for service-specific issues.
useCases.outputs: Service trace, node/path sequence, interfaces, dependencies and failure exposure.

useCases.name: Service Inventory Management
useCases.description: Maintains services and their relationship to circuits, customers, logical resources and physical infrastructure.
useCases.businessValue: Creates the foundation for activation, impact, assurance and customer views.
useCases.outputs: Service catalogue, service-resource mapping, lifecycle status and dependency tree.

useCases.name: Service-to-Resource Traceability
useCases.description: Traces each service through its supporting circuits, interfaces, ports, cards, nodes and physical path.
useCases.businessValue: Provides end-to-end transparency from customer service to network resources.
useCases.outputs: Trace path, supporting objects, impacted resources and navigation links.

useCases.name: Automated Circuit & Service Discovery
useCases.description: Derives circuits and services from configuration, topology and inventory relationships.
useCases.businessValue: Finds services that exist in the network even when inventory records are incomplete.
useCases.outputs: Discovered circuits/services, endpoints, path, confidence score and mismatch list.

useCases.name: Circuit & Connection Lifecycle Management
useCases.description: Manages circuit and connection creation, modification, migration, reroute and dismantling.
useCases.businessValue: Controls the service/resource lifecycle and keeps relationships current.
useCases.outputs: Circuit profile, endpoints, path, status, changes and associated service/customer.

useCases.name: End-to-End Circuit Path Visualization
useCases.description: Shows the complete circuit/service path across nodes, ports, links and technology layers.
useCases.businessValue: Makes complex paths explainable for operations, assurance and customer support.
useCases.outputs: Graphical path, endpoints, intermediate resources, dependencies and impact markers.

useCases.name: Service Activation & Provisioning
useCases.description: Translates approved service requests into resource allocation and network provisioning steps.
useCases.businessValue: Connects fulfillment with inventory and validation to reduce activation errors.
useCases.outputs: Provisioning workflow, resource assignments, configuration steps and activation status.

useCases.name: Activation Feasibility & Resource Validation
useCases.description: Checks whether required resources, paths, capacity, ports and addressing are available before activation.
useCases.businessValue: Prevents failed activation caused by missing or unsuitable resources.
useCases.outputs: Feasibility result, blockers, available options, capacity check and reservation status.

useCases.name: Post-Activation Service Validation
useCases.description: Validates that a newly activated service matches the design and is operational.
useCases.businessValue: Confirms fulfillment quality before service handover.
useCases.outputs: Validation checks, connectivity state, configuration match and acceptance result.

useCases.name: Network Capacity Inventory
useCases.description: Maintains installed, available, allocated, reserved and consumed capacity across network resources.
useCases.businessValue: Provides the baseline needed for utilization, feasibility and expansion decisions.
useCases.outputs: Capacity catalogue, resource headroom, allocated/reserved capacity and capacity ownership.

useCases.name: Port & Interface Capacity Management
useCases.description: Tracks port and interface availability, speed, utilization, reservation and allocation.
useCases.businessValue: Helps teams find usable resources and avoid exhausting critical ports.
useCases.outputs: Port availability, utilization, reservation status, threshold breaches and expansion candidates.

useCases.name: Link & Transmission Capacity Management
useCases.description: Manages bandwidth and utilization across physical and transport links.
useCases.businessValue: Highlights link congestion, weak transport areas and future augmentation needs.
useCases.outputs: Link capacity, utilization, headroom, congestion status and trend.

useCases.name: MPLS Capacity Management
useCases.description: Analyzes capacity across MPLS links, P/PE nodes, interfaces and service paths.
useCases.businessValue: Connects service growth and network backbone load to clear planning actions.
useCases.outputs: MPLS utilization, hot links, path headroom, service load and exhaustion forecast.

useCases.name: Service & Circuit Capacity Management
useCases.description: Correlates service/circuit demand with underlying resource capacity.
useCases.businessValue: Shows which services consume critical capacity and where growth creates risk.
useCases.outputs: Service capacity view, consumed bandwidth, path headroom and impacted customers.

useCases.name: Capacity vs. Inventory Validation
useCases.description: Compares discovered/configured capacity with declared inventory capacity.
useCases.businessValue: Ensures planning decisions are based on real capacity, not stale records.
useCases.outputs: Capacity mismatches, missing speed/bandwidth attributes, source conflict and correction queue.

useCases.name: Capacity Utilization Monitoring
useCases.description: Continuously tracks utilization against thresholds and baselines.
useCases.businessValue: Detects resources approaching congestion before customer impact appears.
useCases.outputs: Utilization status, threshold alerts, trend profile and exception list.

useCases.name: Capacity Trend & Forecasting
useCases.description: Uses historical utilization to forecast when resources will reach defined thresholds.
useCases.businessValue: Provides early planning signals before capacity becomes urgent.
useCases.outputs: Forecast date, trend line, confidence, threshold crossing and recommended timing.

useCases.name: Capacity Exhaustion Prediction
useCases.description: Predicts when resources may run out of usable capacity.
useCases.businessValue: Allows proactive expansion or rerouting before service delivery is constrained.
useCases.outputs: Exhaustion date, risk level, affected resources, expected demand and priority.

useCases.name: Capacity Hotspot Detection
useCases.description: Identifies capacity pressure points and congested clusters across geography, topology and services.
useCases.businessValue: Shows where localized capacity issues may become wider operational problems.
useCases.outputs: Hotspot map, affected resources, trend severity and suggested actions.

useCases.name: Capacity Planning & Expansion Recommendations
useCases.description: Recommends capacity actions based on forecast, business impact, service criticality and topology.
useCases.businessValue: Prioritizes investment where it prevents the highest risk or unlocks important services.
useCases.outputs: Expansion candidates, priority score, justification, impacted services and expected benefit.

useCases.name: Capacity What-If Analysis
useCases.description: Simulates failure, removal, migration or traffic growth and calculates expected impact before it happens.
useCases.businessValue: Supports safer planning and more informed change or expansion decisions.
useCases.outputs: Simulated impact, affected services/customers, capacity after event and risk notes.

useCases.name: Capacity Impact After Failure
useCases.description: Calculates whether surviving resources can absorb traffic after a link/node/path failure.
useCases.businessValue: Reveals hidden resiliency risks that are not visible from normal utilization alone.
useCases.outputs: Post-failure utilization, overloaded survivors, affected services and mitigation options.

useCases.name: Capacity Reservation & Allocation
useCases.description: Tracks reserved versus allocated versus consumed capacity for planned projects and services.
useCases.businessValue: Prevents overbooking and gives fulfillment teams an accurate view of available headroom.
useCases.outputs: Reservation register, allocation status, consumed capacity and release/expiry tracking.

useCases.name: Stranded & Underutilized Capacity Analysis
useCases.description: Finds available or expensive capacity that remains underused while other areas are constrained.
useCases.businessValue: Improves asset utilization and guides optimization before new investment.
useCases.outputs: Underutilized resources, stranded capacity, nearby demand and optimization candidates.

useCases.name: Capacity Dashboard & Executive View
useCases.description: Presents executive and operational capacity KPIs in one dashboard.
useCases.businessValue: Converts detailed capacity analysis into management-ready decisions.
useCases.outputs: Headroom KPIs, hotspots, forecasts, exhaustion risks and expansion priorities.
